# Prince Art Packages (Private) Limited

> Specialized ISO 9001:2015 and cGMP-compliant pharmaceutical secondary packaging manufacturer based in Karachi, Pakistan.

## Company

Prince Art Packages (Private) Limited is a premier pharmaceutical secondary packaging manufacturer serving the healthcare and pharmaceutical industry with precision engineering and zero-defect quality standards.

## Manufacturing & Quality

* Two dedicated manufacturing units in Korangi Creek Industrial Park, Karachi.
* ISO 9001:2015 certified — Certificate No. KQ.2025.5393.
* FSC Chain of Custody certified — RR-COC-003348 / FSC-C222205.
* cGMP and WHO-GMP compliant manufacturing processes, including strict line clearance.
* State-of-the-art Electronic Verification Quality Assurance (QA) System (automated master PDF inspection and optical verification).

## Products

* Folding & Printed Cartons
* High-Density Prescribing Information Leaflets (PIL) & Outserts
* Small-Diameter Vial & Ampoule Printed Labels
* Glass Ampoule Honeycomb Separators
* Dose Adherence Pill-Folders & Sliding Packs
* Tamper-Evident Security Cartons
* 3D-ENGRAVIX™ Optical Security Packaging
* ColdSeal Blister Wallets
